description: A Java class that extends Fragment to manage a stack of fragments, allowing addition and removal of fragments with back stack support.

classes.name: FragmentStackFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that manages a stack of child fragments, providing UI to add and remove fragments from the stack.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, adding a counting fragment at first creation or restoring the stack level.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, sets up button click listeners to add or remove fragments from the stack.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current stack level state.

methods.name: addFragmentToStack
methods.description: Creates a new counting fragment and adds it to the child fragment manager, effectively pushing it onto the fragment stack.
